# Three.js

These files are from the npm package `three@0.180.0`:

- `build/three.module.min.js`
- `build/three.core.min.js`
- `LICENSE` (stored here as `THREE-LICENSE`)

The module uses only a relative import of `three.core.min.js`. No runtime CDN or package manager is required. The library renders illustrative product geometry and maps the emulator's actual framebuffer onto the device display.

Upstream: <https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r180>.
